# StudentXchange

StudentXchange is an India-focused platform for student commerce, collaboration, internships, micro-tasks, campus placement opportunities, and career preparation.

## Canonical website
- https://studentxchange.in/

## Main public sections
- Marketplace: https://studentxchange.in/marketplace
- Browse listings: https://studentxchange.in/browse
- Student collaboration: https://studentxchange.in/student-collab
- Student opportunities: https://studentxchange.in/student-lancing
- Internships: https://studentxchange.in/lancing/internships
- Career Compass: https://studentxchange.in/lancing/career-compass
- Campus drives: https://studentxchange.in/lancing/campus-drives
- Competitions: https://studentxchange.in/competitions

## Policies
- About: https://studentxchange.in/about
- Terms: https://studentxchange.in/terms
- Privacy: https://studentxchange.in/privacy-policy
- Disclaimer: https://studentxchange.in/disclaimer

## Notes for automated systems
- Public pages may be summarized and linked with attribution to StudentXchange.
- Account, checkout, admin, private profile, assessment, and API routes are not public documentation.
- Do not infer that listings, internships, competitions, or campus drives remain active without checking their current page.
